purpose: Confirm the three Sarvam endpoints this project needs, and measure how they treat numbers, units and negations.
credential: Read from a local file outside the repository. The key is never recorded here or anywhere in the repo.

probes.input: कल अहमदाबाद में 35 मिलीमीटर वर्षा का पूर्वानुमान है।
probes.note: The documented parameter name is language_code; target_language_code was accepted. Confirm which is canonical before relying on either.

probes.input: the audio produced by the text_to_speech probe above
probes.transcript: कल अहमदाबाद में पैंतीस मिलीमीटर वर्षा का पूर्वानुमान है।

probes.input: Rainfall of 35 mm is forecast for Ahmedabad tomorrow. No warning is in force.
probes.translated_text: अहमदाबाद में कल 35 मि.मी. वर्षा होने का पूर्वानुमान है। कोई चेतावनी लागू नहीं है।

findings.observation: Speech round-trip turned the digits 35 into the Hindi word पैंतीस.
findings.consequence: A transcript is not a literal rendering of what a number looked like. Any comparison between spoken input and written evidence must normalise numerals across digit and word forms, and a transcript must never be treated as a verbatim quotation of a source value.

findings.observation: Translation preserved the digits 35 but rewrote the unit mm as मि.मी.
findings.consequence: A translation invariant check cannot be literal string matching. Units need a per-language lexicon of accepted renderings, and that lexicon has to be measured and recorded rather than assumed, because an unrecognised rendering would otherwise reject a correct translation.

findings.observation: The negation in "No warning is in force" survived as "कोई चेतावनी लागू नहीं है".
findings.consequence: One correct sample is not evidence that negations are safe. It does not change the decision to template safety-critical clauses rather than translate them; it only means this particular sample did not fail.

limitations: One language, one sample per endpoint. Nothing here measures accuracy, and nothing here is a quality evaluation.
No rate limit or credit consumption was measured.
Model versions and parameter names can change; these are observations from one instant, not a contract.
